items.title: File Einspruch against withdrawal of Kindergeld
items.quote: Gegen diesen Bescheid kann binnen eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe Einspruch bei der Familienkasse Beispielweser eingelegt werden, schriftlich, elektronisch oder zur Niederschrift.
items.computation: The letter states the posting day ('Aufgabe zur Post') explicitly as Samstag, 21.11.2026, and itself says the notice counts as given on the 4th day after that posting day, 'sofern er nicht nachweislich später eingegangen ist.' 21.11.2026 + 4 calendar days = 25.11.2026 (Wed) → deemed delivery/Bekanntgabe. Under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of Bekanntgabe itself is not counted; the one-month Einspruch period (§ 355 AO analogously applied via § 32 Abs. 4 EStG procedure) starts 26.11.2026 and ends, per § 188 Abs. 2 BGB, on the day of the following month bearing the same number as the start day of the period's first day, i.e. 25.12.2026. 25.12.2026 is 1. Weihnachtstag, a public holiday in NW (and nationwide), so under § 108 Abs. 3 AO the deadline shifts to the next working day, Montag 28.12.2026 (26./27.12. also holidays/weekend).

items.title: Last month Kindergeld for Lukas is paid
items.quote: Bis einschließlich Dezember 2026 zahlen wir das Kindergeld von 259,00 € im Monat weiter.
items.computation: The Familienkasse states Kindergeld continues 'bis einschließlich Dezember 2026', i.e. the last entitlement month is December 2026; the benefit for that month covers up to the end of the month, 31.12.2026. From January 2027 the Festsetzung is aufgehoben.

warnings: The letter's own date (19.11.2026, a Thursday) is before the stated 'Aufgabe zur Post' date (21.11.2026, a Saturday); the Einspruch deadline above is computed from the later, explicitly stated posting day, which the letter itself uses as the basis for its 4-day Bekanntgabe rule — if the letter was in fact posted even later than 21.11.2026, the deadline would move further out, so check any postmark on the envelope.
